series: THE HIDDEN WORLD: Case Files (cinematic, engine v3)

01.title: She Got Life for Murder. The 'Blood' Was Sound-Deadener. #Shorts
01.next_task: human-style frame review recorded in production_manifest.json 'editorial_review'
01.episode_summary: Azaria Chamberlain (Uluru, 1980-2012): a mother jailed for life on 'baby's blood' that was factory sound-deadener; a jacket found by chance freed her; a 2012 inquest confirmed a dingo took her daughter.

defects_found_and_fixed: hand-to-face gesture read as a wave -> rebuilt as hand-to-mouth
judge/coroner too small at the bench (scale 0.42 -> 0.5)
verdict shot opened on an empty wall -> tighter start on the bench, Lindy revealed by the tilt down
frontal walk read as a kick -> 3/4 walk with shorter stride
magnifier hidden by the bench -> aimed above it
label boxes collided with the judge's head -> bench figures moved off-centre
night search lacked tension -> subtle handheld camera
animation_director.notes: Character continuity holds across shots by construction (same characters/figures/*.json): Lindy (court/release outfits), Michael, judge, scientist recur unchanged. Remaining limit: 2D cut-out rig, rigid limbs, simple hands.

checks: narration identical to the reviewed, sourced v1 script (tests/test_cinematic.py)
every shot's claims are 'established' with >=2 sources (shot_manifest validation)
no depiction of Azaria, the dingo, violence or blood; dashboard 'spray' drawn dark brown
real people are illustrated representations, not likenesses; others generic
every reconstruction tagged ILLUSTRATION; jacket shot tagged NOT THE ACTUAL JACKET
no invented dialogue; prosecution case labelled as a claim; no 'declared innocent'

retention_strategist.hook: 0-3.6 s: Lindy in the dock under the judge, 'A mother was jailed for life for murdering her baby', gavel hit; 2.9 s later the 'NOT BLOOD' reversal.
retention_strategist.pacing: 14 shots, average 6.0 s, longest 10.7 s (science reveal, three staged callouts); payoff in the 2012 finding; memorial close with fade.
defects_found_and_fixed: captions overflowed the Shorts UI (right 1039 px, bottom 1563 px) -> 800 px safe width at y 1380, long words scaled

software_test_engineer.result: 16/16 QA checks pass; 87 unit tests pass
defects_found_and_fixed: motion-energy metric could not tell a slideshow from animation (v1 also passed) -> kept only as a frozen-picture detector; character action now probed from the renderer
test module name collision between the two make_episodes.py files -> loaded by path
self-matching pgrep in a wait loop -> waits on the real PID

02.title: How the Unabomber's Own Words Gave Him Away #Shorts
02.next_task: human-style frame review recorded in production_manifest.json 'editorial_review'
02.episode_summary: The Unabomber (USA, 1978-1998): seventeen years without a name, until the FBI published his manifesto and his own family recognised the writing - and a twisted old saying.

defects_found_and_fixed: fog drawn over the arrest figures -> fog layer moved behind the figures' plane
newspaper prop read as held by David and Linda -> removed
sentence card covered Ted's head -> moved up
shot sizes monotonous (75 % medium) -> close-ups on the typing silhouette and on David, a wide of the press hall
animation_director.notes: The bomber is a silhouette until he is named (cabin arrest), then the same Ted character appears unchanged at arrest and plea. David, Linda, agents and analyst recur unchanged.

checks: narration identical to the reviewed, sourced v1 script
no explosion, injury or bomb construction: the device is a sealed parcel only
no real masthead, letter or FBI document imitated; page text illegible except verified quotes
the plea (Jan 1998) and sentence (May 1998) dated separately as sourced
defects_found_and_fixed: offer card in first person ('PUBLISH MY... I WILL') would have been a fabricated quote -> third person, only 'desist from terrorism' quoted
'Hired privately by the family' not supported (a family friend, PI Susan Swanson, took the letters to an outside analyst) -> 'Arranged via a family friend'

retention_strategist.hook: 0-7.9 s: 'For seventeen years, the FBI hunted a bomber it couldn't name' over a SUSPECT: UNKNOWN board; 'His own words. And his own brother.' land as two pinned cards.
retention_strategist.pacing: 12 shots, average 7.3 s; the phrase reveal highlights EAT and HAVE on the spoken words; ending lands on 'His own family did.' with a two-shot and fade.
defects_found_and_fixed: shot-size monotony flagged by the QA gate (blocked publishing) -> fixed

software_test_engineer.result: 16/16 QA checks pass after the fix; the first render was correctly refused by the gate (slideshow risk)
defects_found_and_fixed: render inputs hashed so a verified render is reused instead of re-rendered (produce.py)
